app.name: Nokuzo
app.tagline: Every evening at nine, nine people.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.subtitle: Phase 0: design system and settings
foundation.servicesHint: NEEDS_SETUP: this service stays off until an account and key are provided.

demo.inputPlaceholder: Sunday breakfast: big spread or simit and tea?
demo.cardBody: Content cards never use the glass effect.
demo.bannerWarning: Scammers usually want to move to another app right away. Take your time.
demo.sheetBody: Close it with the Close button or the back gesture.

common.offline: No internet connection. Try again once you are online.

cards.title: The Round
cards.body: Nine verified people every evening at 9 pm. No endless swiping.

cards.title: The Door Question
cards.body: There is no like button. You show interest by answering their question.

cards.title: The Table
cards.body: At most three chats at a time. You close one with a kind goodbye; nobody just vanishes.

signIn.title: How would you like to continue?

email.title: Your email address
email.label: Email
email.help: We will send you a 6-digit code.

code.title: Enter the code
code.emailSubtitle: Type the 6-digit code we sent to {{target}}.
code.phoneSubtitle: Type the 6-digit code we sent to {{target}}.
code.label: Verification code
code.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s
code.resent: A new code is on its way.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.subtitle: Each number can belong to one account only. Virtual numbers are not accepted.
phone.label: Mobile number

birthDate.title: Your date of birth
birthDate.subtitle: Nokuzo is for people aged 18 and over. Only your age is shown on your profile, and you cannot change your date of birth later.
birthDate.locked: People under 18 cannot sign up. You can try again in {{time}}.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.subtitle: You cannot continue without the required ones. Nothing is pre-selected.
consents.loadError: The texts could not be loaded.

terms.label: I accept the Terms of Use.

community_guidelines.label: I will follow the Community Guidelines.

kvkk_notice.label: I have read the Privacy Notice (KVKK).

biometric.label: I explicitly consent to the processing of my face data (biometric data) for the liveness check.
biometric.help: The video is deleted right away; only an irreversible face vector and the result are kept.

special_category.label: I explicitly consent to the processing of special category data, such as who I want to see.
special_category.help: This is used only to show you people who match what you are looking for.

cross_border_transfer.label: I explicitly consent to my data being transferred to servers abroad.
cross_border_transfer.help: Our servers are in the European Union (Frankfurt).

marketing.label: I would like to receive news and offers.

liveness.title: Liveness check
liveness.body: We will take a short video selfie to confirm that the person in your photos is really you.
tips: The video is not recorded; it is deleted right away.
Keep your face in good light.
liveness.devBody: This environment uses a mock liveness check instead of the camera, and it always passes. Real users never see this screen.
liveness.nativeMissing: The liveness camera is not available in this build yet.
liveness.failed: The check could not be completed. Check the light and try again.
liveness.cooldown: There were too many failed attempts. You can try again in {{time}}. If the problem continues, contact support.

needsId.title: ID check needed
needsId.body: To confirm your age we need to check an official ID document. This step is coming to the app soon; for now you can contact support.

done.title: You are verified
done.body: Your phone, age and liveness check are done. Profile creation arrives in the next version.

blocked.title: An account cannot be created
blocked.body: An account cannot be created with these details. For help, write to {{email}}.

gate.error: Your details could not be loaded.
gate.notConfiguredBody: This build has no server settings (NEEDS_SETUP). For developers: docs/SETUP.md

errors.invalid_input: Please check the details and try again.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again a little later.
errors.disposable_email: Disposable email addresses are not accepted.
errors.unsupported_country: For now, only Turkish (+90) numbers can sign up.
errors.voip_number: Virtual (VoIP) numbers are not accepted. Enter your mobile number.
errors.otp_invalid: That code is not right. Try again.
errors.otp_expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.otp_locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.underage: Nokuzo is only for people aged 18 and over.
errors.age_locked: People under 18 cannot sign up. You can try again in 24 hours.
errors.birth_date_already_set: Your date of birth is already saved.
errors.consents_incomplete: Please tick all the required consents.
errors.consents_outdated: The texts have been updated. Please review them again.
errors.wrong_step: This step is not available right now. Let us continue where you left off.
errors.liveness_cooldown: There were too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
errors.liveness_failed: The check could not be completed. Try again.
errors.registration_blocked: An account cannot be created with these details. Please contact support.
errors.service_unavailable: This feature is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.network: No internet connection. Try again once you are online.
errors.change_limited: You changed this recently; you can try again later.
errors.photo_limit: You can add up to 6 photos.
errors.not_found: Not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.not_in_tur: This person is no longer in your Round.
errors.saved_limit: You can save up to 9 people. Remove someone first.
errors.answer_invalid: The answer could not be sent. Check the text or the recording.
errors.answer_duplicate: This answer is very similar to your recent ones. Write something just for this person.
errors.answer_limit: You cannot send more answers right now.

profile.pendingReview: Your change is being reviewed; the previous version stays visible until it is approved.

textBlocked.contact_info: Contact details, social media handles or numbers are not allowed.
textBlocked.profanity: This wording goes against the community guidelines.

basics.title: Let us get to know you
basics.subtitle: Your name and who you want to see.
basics.name: Your name
basics.nameHelp: Shown on your profile. You can change it once every 30 days.
basics.showGender: Show my gender on my profile
basics.seeking: Who do you want to see?

photos.title: Your photos
photos.subtitle: At least 3, at most 6 photos. The first must clearly show your own face.
photos.caption: Caption (optional)
photos.limit: You can add up to 6 photos.
photos.needMore: You need at least 3 approved photos to continue.
photos.tooSmall: This photo is too small; the short side must be at least 800 pixels.

reasons.no_face: Your face is not clearly visible in the main photo.
reasons.not_you: The person in the photo did not match your liveness check.
reasons.violence: Photos with violence or weapons are not allowed.
reasons.drugs: Photos with drugs are not allowed.
reasons.text_contact: The photo contains contact details or a social media handle.
reasons.too_small: The photo is too small; the short side must be at least 800 pixels.
reasons.too_large: The photo is larger than 15 MB.
reasons.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported.
reasons.corrupt: The file could not be read.
reasons.possible_minor: A person needs to review this.
reasons.text: In review because of the text in the photo.
reasons.under_review: Our moderation team will review it.

intent.title: What are you looking for?
intent.subtitle: Your intent card is shown on your profile.

tempos.slow: I like to take it slow

intent.dealbreakersHelp: Pick up to 3 fields and tick the options you accept. The Round will not show people who do not fit.
intent.limit: You can pick up to 3 fields.

door.title: Your Door Question
door.subtitle: People who want to reach you will answer this question. You can change it once a week.

location.title: Where are you?
location.subtitle: Others only see your district (or city); distance is never shown as a number.
location.locationHelp: Optional. Your location is rounded to about 1 km; the exact location is never stored.
location.permissionDenied: Location permission was not given. You can turn it on in settings; choosing a city is enough.

details.title: More about you
details.subtitle: All optional. For each one you choose whether it is shown on your profile.

voice.title: Voice card
voice.subtitle: A short 5–20 second recording. Optional.
voice.tooShort: The recording must be at least 5 seconds.
voice.permission: Microphone permission is needed to record.

reasons.unsupported_type: The recording could not be read.

home.title: Me
home.active: Your profile is live. You can edit it here.

reverify.title: Your main photo changed
reverify.body: We need to check again that the person in your photos is you.

tur.title: Tonight’s Round
tur.error: The Round could not be loaded.
tur.notOpenBody: Every evening at 21:00, 9 people are waiting for you. Until then you can polish your profile.
tur.emptyBody: We never show anyone outside your filters. You may want to widen them a little.
tur.finishedBody: You have seen everyone for today. The next Round opens tomorrow at 21:00.

decided.answered: You answered. If they reply, you will see it in Tables.
decided.passed: You passed. You will not see this person for 60 days.
decided.saved: Saved for later. You can answer within 7 days.

tur.whyHint: Flips the card to explain why this person is shown
tur.unavailable: This profile can no longer be shown.
tur.noReasons: They match your filters; we found no stand-out common ground.
tur.howItWorks: Payment, device and spending never affect the order. Compatibility, activity and reply reliability do.
tur.lessQuestion: What would you like to see less of?
tur.lessDone: Got it, we will weigh this less in future Rounds.
tur.widerDistance: Adding 10 km to the distance would bring {{count}} more.
tur.widerAge: Widening the age range by 3 years each way would bring {{count}} more.

answer.title: Your answer
answer.gone: This card is no longer open.
answer.textHelp: 10–200 characters. Emoji alone is not enough.
answer.sentTitle: Your answer is on its way
answer.sentBody: If {{name}} replies, a table opens in Tables.
answer.similarWarning: Your recent answers are very similar. If the next one is not personal, it will not be sent.

invalid.too_short: The answer must be at least 10 characters.
invalid.too_long: The answer can be at most 200 characters.
invalid.emoji_only: Emoji alone is not enough; write a few words.

limit.daily: You sent 15 answers today. You can send more tomorrow.
limit.pending: You have 15 answers waiting. You can send a new one when one drops.

inbox.title: Answers
inbox.emptyIncoming: No answers yet. An interesting Door Question brings answers.
inbox.emptyOutgoing: You have not answered anyone yet.
inbox.gone: This answer is no longer available.
inbox.messageHelp: Write a message; a table opens and the chat starts with it.
inbox.openedBody: Your message is on the table. It is their turn now.
inbox.waitingBody: One of you has no free table. If a slot opens within 72 hours the chat starts; otherwise we tell you both why.

tables.title: Tables
tables.empty: No tables yet. They appear here when you reply to an answer or someone replies to yours.
tables.chatSoon: Chat arrives with the next update.
tables.waitingBody: They open in order when a table frees up.
tables.waitingLeft: {{hours}} h {{minutes}} min for a slot to open

filters.title: Filters
filters.subtitle: The Round only shows people who match these filters and match you back.
filters.ageHelp: The range must be at least {{span}} years.
filters.voiceOnly: Only people with a voice card
filters.more: Dealbreakers and who I want to see
filters.smallPool: The pool is small; your Rounds may not fill 9 cards. Consider widening the filters.
filters.saved: Saved. The next Round uses these filters.

saved.title: Saved
saved.subtitle: {{count}} of {{max}} people. They are not told.
saved.error: The list could not be loaded.
saved.empty: Nobody saved. Use “Save for later” in the Round to add someone here.
